title: Mountains
source: After the notes' South America physical maps, with standard UPSC facts added

places.name: Andes
places.significance: The longest mountain range on Earth: young fold mountains running the whole Pacific edge of South America through seven countries
notes: The longest mountain range in the world, about 7,000 km
Runs through Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Chile and Argentina — 7 countries

places.name: Cordillera Oriental
places.significance: The Andes' eastern range in the north, carrying Bogotá's plateau up through Colombia into Venezuela
notes: Mainly in Colombia, a small part in Venezuela

places.name: Cotopaxi
places.significance: One of the highest active volcanoes on Earth, a perfect snow cone on the avenue of volcanoes south of Quito

places.name: Chimborazo
places.significance: Ecuador's highest peak, whose summit — on the Equator's bulge — is the farthest point on Earth from its centre

places.name: Huascarán
places.significance: Peru's highest peak and the highest in the tropics, crowning the Cordillera Blanca

places.name: Misti
places.significance: The snow-capped cone that looms over Arequipa

places.name: Ojos del Salado
places.significance: The highest active volcano on Earth, on the Argentina–Chile border above the Atacama

places.name: Aconcagua
places.significance: The highest peak of South America — and of the world outside Asia — near the Argentina–Chile border
notes: The highest peak of South America, 6,961 m
In Argentina's Mendoza province, close to the border with Chile
